summary: Barclays: £9.1B PBT (+12% in 2025). Investment bank income £13B (+11%). CEO Venkat: 'accelerating ambition.' Doubling digital/AI investment. Tesco Bank integration. Plans for >£15B capital returns 2026-2028. US consumer bank (Best Egg) growth. GenAI and agile platforms. IT incident Jan 2025 (mainframe) cost £5-7.5M.

business_segments.name: Barclays UK
business_segments.detail: Ring-fenced retail bank. 20M+ customers. Personal banking, Barclaycard UK, business banking. Tesco Bank retail integration (Nov 2024). 146K mortgage completions in 2025. Digital channels.

business_segments.name: Barclays Investment Bank
business_segments.detail: £13B income 2025 (+11%). Global Markets +15%. Equities, FICC, advisory, underwriting. Top 5 market share ambition. US and UK focus. Chetan Vohra appointed Global Head Securitized Products.

business_segments.name: Barclays UK Corporate Bank
business_segments.detail: 13K+ businesses. Robust income growth 2025. Greg Mayfield now leads Global Transaction Banking. Payments (Cat Sheridan), Trade & Working Capital.

business_segments.name: US Consumer Bank
business_segments.detail: Credit cards (partnerships). Best Egg. Online deposits. Auto lending. Growth target via organic + acquisitions.

business_segments.name: Private Bank & Wealth Management
business_segments.detail: Growing AUM. Transactional activity strong 2025. Adrish Ghosh appointed Head of Private Bank India (Aug 2025). Increasing non-interest income.

technology.ai: GenAI + copilots integrated into unified internal systems. AI for productivity, fraud detection, credit risk, customer service. Craig Bright (Group CIO): 'scaling AI at Barclays' (Jul 2025). Intelligent assistants for customers. AI-powered search unifying internal tools. Plans to double digital/AI investment.
technology.cloud: Major cloud transformation. Agile scalable platforms. Craig Bright brought cloud expertise from Westpac and Citi. Technology campuses globally (Radbroke, Glasgow, Pune, Whippany NJ).
technology.data: Unified data platforms initiative with GenAI. Solving fragmentation. Customer analytics. Risk data. Regulatory reporting. Real-time transaction monitoring.
technology.platforms: Mobile banking (Barclays app). Business banking digital. Trading platforms. Open banking. Barclays Execution Services (BX) technology and operations entity.
technology.spend: Doubling digital transformation investment over 2026-2028 period. Cost-income ratio target: low 50s by 2028.

operating_model: 2025 PBT £9.1B (+12%). New targets: >14% ROTE, >£15B returns. Doubling AI/digital. Cost-income low 50s by 2028. Tesco Bank integration.
